accounts_email_or_phone.name: accounts_email_or_phone
accounts_email_or_phone.value: "email" is not null or "phone" is not null

feedback_session_rated.name: feedback_session_rated
feedback_session_rated.value: "kind" <> 'session' or ("session_id" is not null and "rating" is not null)

key_rules_amounts.name: key_rules_amounts
key_rules_amounts.value:
("type" = 'new_account' and "min_usd" is null and "max_usd" is null)
        or ("type" = 'tier' and "min_usd" > 0 and ("max_usd" is null or "max_usd" >= "min_usd"))
